observations.method: Original layer-aware contour association, independent retained-top/floor probes, full incoming-height through rays.

P1.probe_selection: 25 deterministic spread positions on original retained top, excluding the pocket and holes with a two-cell guard; no result-driven selection.

floor.probe_selection: 25 deterministic original retained-floor probes, excluding declared holes plus two cells; no result-driven selection.

observations.section_request_policy: Original-CAD layer boundaries determine stable interior slices before reading the mesh; no geometry rounding or result-driven registration.
